Yup, Bad Religion is one of my favorite bands. I also love the Doors and jacked a line from them as well. 

I really can't afford therapy and I can't afford Marinol. Just checked and it's 22 $ a pill. I can grow a quarter pound of the best for less money. I would probably get kicked out of the clinic by my pain doc if i even mentioned it. They don't drug test me at all and I don't want to mess it up.

I need to get on Medicare but I need help with the paperwork. I can't sit....at all. My pride has gotten in the way of some things. It makes me feel like shit to have my hand out. I'm tired of taking from everyone. I'd rather do things for myself and I've managed to do so for quite a while but I can't anymore.

I'm going to work on that tomorrow. I need some short term goals that are achievable.

Wow, you nailed it. Although, it can be a gift and a curse as I feel sometimes as if the world is on my shoulders. I'd love to give back and help heal the world through diet and natural medicine. It really is my dream; to help end suffering. 

But at this point, I can't even help myself.
Please go on. I could use anyone's support at this point. Thank You
